starter_packs.tagline: A complete creative environment for UI/UX and visual designers

starter_packs.tagline: Record, edit, and publish content like a pro
starter_packs.description: Built for YouTubers, streamers, podcasters, and social media creators. Covers screen recording, video editing, audio production, live streaming, and graphic design in one clean install list.

starter_packs.name: Data Science Setup
starter_packs.tagline: From raw data to insight without the environment headaches
